messages:
Ana CSM: dropping a 'launch-lane' micro-runbook for ramping new tenants. focus: simple, copyable steps for CS during a call.
Jordan SRE: love short. include a probe cmd and a 1-line health metric we can show on the CS card.
Ana CSM: ok: 5 steps: preflight metrics, warm probe, 3-sample warmup, adaptive-prefill, 30m feedback & escalate.
Miles Eng: runtime notes: hydration window=75s small / 3.5m medium. adaptive defaults: max_batch_size=10, batch_window_ms=220, latency_slo_ms=280. start concurrency=1-2.
Jordan SRE: probe one-liner for field:
```bash
# count warm workers and tag session
redwoodctl pools list --tenant=$TENANT --state=warm --count || echo 0
curl -s -X POST $CONSOLE/internal/mark -d "tenant=$TENANT&tag=launch-lane" -H "Authorization: Bearer $INT_TOKEN"
```
Ana CSM: health metric suggestion: show 'launch_health' calculated as:
`launch_health = 1 - clamp(0.55*(1 - prefill_hit) + 0.3*(early_err/0.01) + 0.15*(median_latency/1000), 0, 1)`
Miles Eng: recommended thresholds: launch_health < 0.7 => follow escalation; early_err normalized by 0.01. fallback: if streaming_drop_rate > 0.9% for 7m, switch to non-streaming and set batch_window_ms=360; notify eng-sre.
Ana CSM: customer-facing 30m feedback card (send after handoff):
"""
Quick 30m check: 1) Are responses matching your expectations? 2) Any repeated truncation/timeouts? 3) If we prefill one prompt next, which one?
Please paste any error IDs you saw.
"""
Jordan SRE: telemetry: require header `x-rw-launch:tenant-<id>` on handoff traffic so we can auto-build a 24h dashboard slice.
Ana CSM: TL;DR for CS script: "Run warm probe, send 3 sample queries, enable adaptive-prefill defaults, monitor launch_health for 1m signals, escalate if <0.7, collect 30m feedback."  I'll add a one-click probe button when ops can support it.
run-bot: sys: launch-lane preflight for tenant alpha-7 at 4123456820 completed :white_check_mark: (warm=1)
Miles Eng: I'll add note to prefer quantization=latency-priority for short chat flows. Ana, go ahead and convert to playbook link.
Ana CSM: thanks all — will publish and ping channel when live :thumbsup:
